title: Acceptance evaluation: warn on source-changing turns bound to an item under evaluation; resubmit once after a 409 only for non-source observations
outcome: Reported by Engram::Opus (mailbox #212 and #214; the Engram side is w-64a5f7f0a5e3). The evaluation of w-f0ca1bb7ef80 (delegation-40091648, session-7650) got HTTP 409 twice: 'the run changed after evidence basis 205'. Position 206 was an execution_observation (source_changed=true) for an unrelated doc edit, booked to w-f0ca because the session's binding had followed focus there (Engram's documented rule: a note targeting a work item establishes focus; TermAl's binding refresh behaved correctly). Agreed TermAl changes: (a) while TermAl has an evaluation in flight for item X, a source-changing turn in a session bound to X shows a visible warning; (b) on a 409 whose new feed entries are ALL non-source-changing host observations, the evaluator refreshes its evidence basis and resubmits once. Never resubmit when any new entry has source_changed=true: the verdict would be about files the evaluator never saw.
